721180101.text: Finally! At long last, it is done! Fortunately, I remember these specifications...

721180102.text: So, we're going in to purify the Tatarigami energy, then?

721180103.text: Well, as much as I would love to get in there and wrap this up, we must not act so rashly when faced with the Tatarigami.

721180104.text: Moreover, some of the required materials I simply could not find, so I had to make do with some last-minute substitutions. The result being that the reliability of this device is somewhat...

721180105.text: Hmm. Well, let me just say that "in some circumstances, it may not achieve the desired efficacy."

721180106.text: It can be used normally just fine, yes, but I doubt that it can withstand any accidents. The slightest jolt will likely knock some of the components out of place...

721180107.text: As such, we still require a little more preparation before we can put our new friend here to work.

721180108.text: I'd like you to go near the Mikage Furnace and record some data for me.

721180110.text: Thank you very much. I'll be waiting for you here.

721180112.text: Of course we do. To tell you the truth, I'm already cutting out quite a few steps here compared to the proper protocol. If Mr. Flois were here, it would be another week before we'd finish working through his process.

721180113.text: Anyway, desperate times call for desperate measures, and as representative of the project review panel, technically this is my call... so, I hereby authorize us to adapt our approach to suit the situation.

subQuests.subQuestName: Take a picture of the situation at the Mikage Furnace

721180301.text: So, have you scouted the situation out?

subQuests.subQuestName: Take a picture of the situation at the Mikage Furnace

721180402.text: We're in luck, it seems. The Mikage Furnace is quite stable, and the energy within is not yet over-saturated.

721180403.text: At this level of concentration, my device will still hold out.

721180404.text: Do we need to purify all that energy?

721180405.text: If this device could do that, why, I would have applied for a patent long ago. But our fine friend here can only decrease the energy level in a localized area.

721180406.text: However, the reason for the deactivation of the Mikage Furnace and the failure of even its auto-restart program is the high saturation of Tatarigami energy.

721180407.text: As long as we find the area with the highest concentration and purify it, we should be able to restart the core.

721180408.text: At that point, the Mikage Furnace should restart, and beyond that point, any further issues will not be our concern.

721180409.text: That's the plan. But before we execute it, I still have a few final preparations to make.

721180501.text: The Fatui are acting more and more strangely. They seem to be gathering around the core of the furnace.

721180502.text: Hopefully, they aren't hatching some other dastardly plot. Or should I say, trying to do something that we won't be able to mitigate...

721180201.text: I wonder if Inazuma did appointed a project manager for this whole Mikage Furnace business...
